verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll provides a comprehensive, well-documented public REST API covering payroll, contractors, time off, webhooks, versioning, authentication, idempotency, pagination, error handling, official client libraries/SDKs, and even an official MCP server enabling AI agents to interact directly with the API and docs. This is extensive first-party documentation with a probe confirming the docs endpoints resolve live; missing for 10: independent third-party developer accounts of building against the API to corroborate the docs.
